changelog: Insert a discrete question about single obligatory heads/complements to correct the understating of risk when the right fragment supplies the sole element that completes or flips the left (addresses finding 1).
Insert guidance about separation of noun heads, titles, determiners or appositives to raise cohesion penalties when modifiers are orphaned (addresses finding 2).
Paraphrased C7 to compress English-specific cues into a shorter, clearer checklist so we free space while preserving guidance (addresses critique about isolating short right fragments).

Rewrote C8 to add two compact, discrete checks (single-obligatory-element and noun-head/apposition) and an explicit caution against rewarding cuts that isolate tiny completing fragments; keeps the core two-question framing but makes the new checks concrete and brief (direct response to both findings).

Replace C8 to keep the two-question framing but add two concise, discrete checks (single-obligatory-element and noun-head/apposition) and an explicit caution against rewarding cuts that isolate tiny one-word completions — addresses both critic findings about missed high-risk positions and orphaned modifiers.
